observations.behavior: Replaces exception handling around ThreadPoolExecutor results; explicitly raises OwnershipUnavailable on timeout rather than catching TimeoutError separately, while adding a finally block that cancels remaining futures without waiting.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes batch fetch behavior during warehouse or repository ownership lookups; this could reduce thread blocking and allow faster failure recovery, though it relies on downstream chunk-level enforcement.
